name: empty
description: The "nothing" attribute. New objects automatically have their attributes filled with this.

name: Damage
description: Does damage in the amount specified by the parameter. MR is not taken into account.

name: AC
description: Modifies the AC value specified by the parameter, this AC is NOT affected by the targets weight. Used in barkskin and stoneskin.

name: Rcol
description: Modifies resistance to cold by the value specified by the parameter.

name: Max Damage
description: Modifies max damage to the value specified by the parameter.

name: Rfir
description: Modifies resistance to fire by the value specified by the parameter.

name: Enslave
description: Charms the target.

name: DR
description: Modifies the DR value specified by the parameter. Note that DR is expressed in multiples of 10.

name: Drain
description: Drains HP from the target to the caster. (usually seen in spells)

name: Shadow
description: Displays "A shadowy figure!" when looked at by other players.

name: AC(Blur)
description: Modifies the AC value specified by the parameter, this AC IS affected by the targets encumberance. Used in blur, and the spell for the amethyst pendant.

name: EnergyLevel
description: Modifies the Energy level specified by the parameter.

name: Summon
description: Summons a monster specified by the parameter. The value in parameter is the monster number.

name: Illu
description: Increases or decreases the light value for the target ONLY by the value specified in the parameter.

name: RoomIllu
description: Increases or decreases the light value for the entire room by the value specified in the parameter.

name: Alterhunger
description: Unknown

name: Alter thirst
description: Unknown

name: Damage(-MR)
description: Does damage which takes into account the targets MR (or so the name implies).

name: Heal
description: Heals damage specified by the value in the parameter.

name: Poison
description: Poisons the target doing damage specified by the value in the parameter.

name: Cure Poison
description: Cures poison (cure poison has a parameter of 8, as does antidote).

name: ImmuPoison
description: Used in duration spells to make the target immune to poison.

name: Accuracy
description: Increases the targets accuracy by the value specified in the parameter. (bless increases this value by 3, divine favour increases it by 10)

name: AffectsUndead
description: Used to make a spell ONLY work on undead monsters.

name: ProtEvil
description: Protection from evil.

name: ProtGood
description: Protection from good.

name: DetectMagic
description: Detects the magic in an item.

name: Stealth
description: Modifies stealth by the value in the parameter.

name: Magical
description: Defines the magical potency of an item. Witchunters cannot use items with this flag. To make a non-magical item hit highly magical creatures, use the HitMagic flag.

name: Punch
description: Used in the Mystic class definition to grant the Punch ability. A parameter of +1 is used in their definition.

name: Kick
description: Used in the Mystic class definition to grant the Kick ability. A parameter of +1 is used in their definition.

name: Bash
description: Used in almost all class definition to grant the ability to bash attack monsters.

name: Smash
description: Unknown

name: Killblow
description: Unknown

name: Dodge
description: Increases or decreases the targets ability to Dodge by the % value specified in the parameter.

name: JumpKick
description: Used in the Mystic class definition to grant the JumpKick ability. A parameter of +1 is used in their definition.

name: M.R.
description: Increases or decreases the targets MR by the value specified in the parameter.

name: Picklocks
description: In Race and Class definitions, this grants the ability to Picklock, in items, this can be used to enhance the ability.

name: Tracking
description: Used in Race and Class definitions to grant Tracking to a Race/Class.

name: Thievery
description: In Race and Class definitions, this grants the ability to Rob, in items, this can be used to enhance the ability.

name: FindTraps
description: In Race and Class definitions, this grants the ability to find traps, in items, this can be used to enhance the ability.

name: DisarmTraps
description: In Race and Class definitions, this grants the ability to disarm traps, in items, this can be used to enhance the ability.

name: LearnSp
description: Places the spell specified in the parameter into the players spells list. Also used for Kai powers and Bard songs. Use this in a

id: scroll item. The parameter is the spell number.

name: CastsSp
description: Casts the spell when an item is 'used', or, with the %Spell attribute, this is the spell that is cast when the % chance is met.

name: Intel
description: Increases or decreases the Intel stat by the value specified in the parameter.

name: Wisdom
description: Increases or decreases the Wisdom/Willpower stat by the value specified in the parameter.

name: Strength
description: Increases or decreases the Strength stat by the value specified in the parameter.

name: Health
description: Increases or decreases the Health stat by the value specified in the parameter.

name: Agility
description: Increases or decreases the Agility stat by the value specified in the parameter.

name: Charm
description: Increases or decreases the Charm stat by the value specified in the parameter.

name: MageBaneQuest
description: This Determines if the player has completed the MageBane quest.

name: AntiMagic
description: Used in the Witchunter class definition, apperently the only effect being that MR effects beneficial as well as combat spells cast on the target.

name: EvilInCombat
description: Used in spells to generate evil warnings and give EP when used.

name: BlindingLight
description: Unknown

name: IlluTarget
description: Increases or decreases the light level for the target specified by the value in the parameter.

name: AlterGeneralLightDuration
description: Unknown

name: RechargeItem
description: Unknown

name: SeeHidden
description: Grants the ability to see hidden players. For monsters, this allows them to see hidden players and attack them while they are sneaking or hiding. The monster will also follow even if the player escapes and re-sneaks.

name: Crits
description: Increases or decreases the targets critical hit chance by the value specified in the parameter.

name: ClassOk
description: Used in items to make the item equippable by classes they aren't intended to be used with.

name: Fear
description: Makes the target flee in fear. Used in duration spells.

name: AffectExit
description: Unknown

name: EvilChance
description: Unknown

name: Experience
description: Unknown (although one would assume this can be used to add/remove experience)

name: AddCP
description: Unknown (although one would assume this can be used to add/remove CP)

name: ResistStone
description: Modifies resistance to stone by the value specified by the parameter.

name: Rlit
description: Modifies resistance to lightning by the value specified by the parameter.

name: Quickness
description: does in fact make you walk faster (but only to a point so that it only matters if you're heavy.)

name: Slowness
description: Modifies the room movement time while not affecting stealth as a modified encumbrance would. The Mage spell "Slow" uses a parameter of +200 for this attribute.

name: MaxMana
description: Increases or decreases the targets maximum mana by the value specified in the parameter.

name: S.C.
description: Incresaes or decreases the targets SC by the value specified in the parameter.

name: Confusion
description: Confuses the target, making them fumble in the % specified by the parameter. A parameter of +50 would make them fumble 50% of the time-- most "stun" spells use this with a value of +100, which makes the target fumble 100% of the time.

name: DamageShield
description: Used to setup a shockshield for the player. Shockshield uses this.

name: DispellMagic
description: cancels spells that affect the ability in the value (ie dispellmagic +107 cancels spells giving the "blind" ability), but probably only certain ones

name: HoldPerson
description: Holds the target in the room. Used with duration spells. Entangle and Hold Person use this attribute.

name: Paralyze
description: Unknown

name: Mute
description: Strikes the target mute, making them unable to talk in rooms, etc.

name: Percep
description: Increases or decreases the targets perception by the value specified in the parameter.

name: Animal
description: Used in monster attributes to flag a monster as an animal. See "Affects Animals".

name: MageBind
description: did use to make spellcasting impossible but not sure it's still working.

name: AffectsAnimals
description: Used in spells to make it ONLY affect animals.

name: Freedom
description: Frees the target from holding spells and spells that alter the targets speed.

name: Cursed
description: Used on items, once worn, a Cursed item can't be removed.

name: CURSED
description: has the same affects as 82 (curse) so you can't remove an item but it also makes it not drop at death (unlike 82).. although the item is still unequipped at death so it kinda doesn't work right.

name: Rcrs
description: Remove curse. Seen in spells. The Priest spell "Remove Curse" uses this flag. Removes all cursed items.

name: Shatter
description: Shatters the targets weapon. The parameter (in theory) specifies which "Quality" of weapons the spell affects and can shatter. The Druid sell "Shatter" specifies a parameter of 1, and thus will not work on items with a Quality of or greater than 1.

name: Quality
description: Specifies an items "Quality". The only effect of this is to counter "Shatter". See "Shatter".

name: Speed
description: Increases or decreases the targets swing speed with their weapon or attack by the value specified in the parameter. The Mage spell "Speed" uses +85 for a parameter, the Mage spell "Slow" uses +125.

name: Alter HP
description: increases or decreases the targets max HP

name: PunchACY
description: believed to alter punch accuracy value

name: KickACY
description: believed to alter kick accuracy value

name: JumpKACY
description: believed to alter jump accuracy value

name: PunchDmg
description: Increases punch damage for the Mystic punch attack.

name: KickDmg
description: Increases kick damage for the Mystic kick attack.

name: JumpKDmg
description: Increases jumpkick damage for the Mystic jumpkick attack.

name: Slay
description: Unknown. Used by the "laen longsword" item.

name: Encum
description: Increases or decreases the targets encumberance % by the value specified in the parameter.

name: Good
description: In spells and items, makes the spell/item useable only by Good aligned characters.

name: Evil
description: In spells and items, makes the spell/item useable only by Evil aligned characters.

name: AlterDRpercent
description: changes DR by the % in the value (is cast by some Mod 9 monsters with negative values.)

name: LoyalItem
description: Makes the item stay with the player even into death. Seen in items.

name: ConfuseMsg
description: Sets the confusion message for a previous "Confusion" attribute. The parameter specifies the message number to use for when the player is confused and fumbles. For the Mage spell "confusion", the message is along the lines of "You fumble in confusion!".

name: RaceStealth
description: Used in Race definitions to grant racial stealth.

name: ClassStealth
description: Used in Class definitions to grant class stealth.

name: DefenseModifier
description: Unknown

name: Accuracy(2)
description: Increases or decreases accuracy by the value specified in the parameter.

name: Accuracy (3)
description: Increases or decreases accuracy by the value specified in the parameter.

name: BlindUser
description: Blinds the target.

name: AffectsLiving
description: Used in spells to limit their abilities to only living players or monsters. See "NonLiving"

name: NonLiving
description: Used in monster attributes to flag the monster as being Non Living which makes it impossible to cast spells flagged as AffectsLiving on them. See "AffectsLiving"

name: NotGood
description: Used in items/spells to flag the object as being useable by any alignment EXCEPT Good. (Neutral, Seedy, Outlaw, Criminal, Villain and FIEND can use it, but Good, Saint, Lawful cannot.)

name: NotEvil
description: Used in items/spells to flag the object as being useable by any alignment EXCEPT Evil. (Lawful, Saint, Good, Neutral and Seedy can use it, but Outlaw, Criminal, Villain and FIEND cannot.)

name: Neutral
description: In spells and items, makes the spell/item useable only by Neutral aligned characters.

name: NotNeutral
description: Used in items/spells to flag the object as being useable by any alignment EXCEPT Neutral. (Lawful, Saint, Good, Outlaw, Criminal, Villain and FIEND can use it, but Neutral and Seedy cannot.)

name: %Spell
description: Used in items to make a "spell effect" occur on a percent chance on each hit or crit. The spell cast is specified by the NEXT "CastsSp" attribute. See "CastsSp".

name: DescMsg
description: Used in spells. Specifies the message in WCCMSG.DAT to use when the spell wears off, when you are looked at, and when you type 'STAT' to see the effect listed.

name: BSAccu
description: Used in items (although I can see no reason why it couldn't be used in a spell) to specify the backstab accuracy for the weapon. A positive value increases the chance to hit, a negative value decreases the chance to hit.

name: BsMinDmg
description: Used in items (although I can see no reason why it couldn't be used in a spell) to specify a higher (or lower) minimum backstab damage for the weapon when armed.

name: BsMaxDmg
description: Used in items (although I can see no reason why it couldn't be used in a spell) to specify a higher (or lower) maximum backstab damage for the weapon when armed.

name: Del@Maint
description: Used in items to delete the item, hidden or not, at cleanup.

name: StartMsg
description: Used in spells to specify the 'start message' for the spell.Basically, this sets the opening line for the spell before the Cast Message is sent.

name: Recharge
description: Used in items to specify the amount of "uses" to recharge at cleanup.

name: RemovesSpell
description: Used in spells to remove other spells (cancel them out).

name: HPRegen
description: Used in any object to modify the targets HP regen rate. The Druid spell "Rapid Healing" and the module-1 quest rings use this attribute.

name: NegateAbility
description: Removes the ability number?

name: IceSorcQuest
description: This is the progress the player has made with the Ice Sorceress quest.

name: GoodQuest
description: This is the progress the player has made with the GOOD quest.

name: NeutralQuest
description: This is the progress the player has made with the NEUTRAL quest.

name: EvilQuest
description: This is the progress the player has made with the EVIL quest.

name: DarkDruidQuest
description: This is the progress the player has made with the Dark Druid quest.

name: BloodChampQuest
description: This is the progress the player has made with the Blood Champion quest.

name: SheDragonQuest
description: This is the progress the player has made with the SheDragon quest.

name: WereratQuest
description: This is the progress the player has made with the Wererat quest.

name: PhoenixQuest
description: This is the progress the player has made with the Phoenix feather quest.

name: DaoLordQuest
description: This is the progress the player has made with the DaoLord quest.

name: MinLevel
description: Typically seen in items (useless for spells since they have their own internal Minimum level field) to restrict them to players ONLY of the level specified or higher. The value in the parameter is the minimum level.

name: MaxLevel
description: Typically seen in items to restrict them to players ONLY of the level specified or LOWER. The value in the parameter is the maximum level.

name: Shock
description: Sets the Shockshield message for the spell/item. See "DmgShield".

name: RoomVisible
description: Makes the item visible to the entire room.

name: SpellImmu
description: Used in objects to make the target immune to spells below or equal to the level specified in the parameter.

name: TeleportRoom
description: Teleports the target to the specified room in the parameter. Usually seen with a "Teleport map". See "Teleport map".

name: TeleportMap
description: Teleports the target to the specified map in the parameter. Usually seen with a "Teleport room". See "Teleport room".

name: HitMagic
description: Seen in weapons (and possibly could be used in spells) and used to make them hit magical creatures of the value specified in the parameter or LOWER. HitMagic +5 for example would let the target hit monsters with a magical attribute of 5 or lower.

name: ClearItem
description: Poofs or unequips item number?

name: NonMagicalSpell
description: Flags the spell as non-magical, thus making it immune to MR.

name: ManaRgn
description: Used in objects to increase or decrease the targets mana regen by the percent specified in the parameter. A value of +25 would increase the targets mana regen by 25%. A value of +100 would increase the targets mana regen by 100% (double).

name: MonsGuards
description: Used in monster definitions to define a monster that protects this one. The parameter points to an entry in the monster database that will protect this one. Multiple MonsGuards can be used to make the monster be protected by different monsters.

name: ResistWater
description: Increases or decreases the targets resistance to Water by the value specified in the parameter.

name: TextBlock
description: Executes the text block specified by the parameter.

name: Remove@Maint
description: Used in items-- removes the item at cleanup, poofing it.

name: HealMana
description: Regenerates mana back by the value specified in the parameter.

name: EndCast
description: Used in spell definitions to chain to another spell at the end of the current ones cast. EndCast is only called if the first spell doesn't fail.

name: Rune
description: Flags the object as a Rune. Seen in one item.

name: KillSpell
description: Kills a spell without calling it's EndCast effect (if one exists).

name: Visible@Maint
description: Used in items to keep them visible at cleanup.

name: DeathText
description: Unknown (executes the specified text block when the player dies?)

name: QuestItem
description: Makes the item a quest item

name: ScatterItems
description: Scatters the items in the room to the specified room(s). You can use a range to specify multiple rooms, but, these rooms must all be a part of the current map.

name: ReqToHit
description: Monsters with this flag require that weapons (and spells?) with this IDENTICAL flag (including parameter) be used to attack it. NOTHING else will work on these monsters.

name: KaiBind
description: Prevents the target from using Kai powers. Seen in 1.1u's race change to Half-Ogre's.

name: GiveTempSpell
description: Unknown (gives the spell specified in Value/Parameter temporarily, as in, it appears in the spells/powers list? Maybe used in future items to give out spells only if a player has a specific item or has a specific item armed/equipped?)

name: OpenDoor
description: Unknown (opens a door, I assume, but how it determines direction/etc is unknown)

name: Lore
description: Unknown

name: SpellComponent
description: Make the item a spell component.

name: CastOnEnd%
description: cast a spell specificed in the next EndCast ability when this spell ends only Value % chance of the time

name: AlterSpDmg
description: Unknown (alter spells damage (eg: used in an item or another spell to temporarily increase all spells damage)?)

name: AlterSpLength
description: Unknown (alter the length of duration spells (eg: used in an item or another spell to temporarily increase all future spells durations)?)

name: UnEquipItem
description: Unknown (remove either the specific item, or, perhaps the value is an item location? (head, arms, etc)?)

name: EquipItem
description: Unknown (equip either the specific item, or, perhaps the value is an item location? (head, arms, etc)? and the first elgible item found in the players inventory is used?)

name: CannotWearLocation
description: Unknown (perhaps used to make an item that can be worn on multiple locations, but, this flag is used to define WHICH locations it cannot be used on?)

name: Sleep
description: Unknown

name: Invisibility
description: Unknown (some new form of stealth perhaps that doesn't rely on Stealth?)

name: SeeInvisible
description: Unknown (most likely a way for monsters/players to see others with this new Invisible ability)

name: Scry
description: Unknown (perhaps show the room specificed in the value? No idea really)

name: StealMana
description: Unknown (most likely steals Mana from another Player or monster for the value specified (or min/max in a spell))

name: StealHPtoMP
description: Unknown (convert stolen HP to Mana instead? Works like the other 'Steal' abilities?)

name: StealMPtoHP
description: Unknown (convert stolen Mana to HP instead? Works like the other 'Steal' abilities?)

name: SpellColours
description: Unknown (perhaps a way to specific the ANSI colour coding for spells, overriding the default colours for the spell?)

name: Shadowform
description: This functions much like shadowform except the value states which text block to display when the player is looked at.

name: FindTrapsValue
description: alters user's Traps Value

name: PickLocksValue
description: alters user's PickLocks Value

name: GHouseDeed
description: Gang House Deed value

name: GHouseTax
description: Gang House Tax value

name: GHouseItem
description: Gang House Item

name: GShopItem
description: Gang Shop Item (controller)

name: BadAttk
description: Do not Attack if Item Nmbr

name: PerStealth
description: Perfect Stealth

name: Meditate
description: Meditate skill granted
